_about: Per piece: base-mesh vertex ranges [first, last]. While the piece is worn, hide every body triangle whose three corners are ALL listed. Match against the _MHVERT attribute of base_*.glb. hide_base_nodes: base underwear meshes (node names in base_*.glb) to hide too.

layers._about: Rules for two pieces worn together (rest pose, piece space, y up, metres). For each rule, every outer piece in outer_folders (matching outer_match, if given) with a number for its measure (at least min_measure, if given) hides, in every inner piece in inner_folders (matching inner_match, if given), the triangles whose three corners all lie above (hide=above) or below (hide=below) that number plus margin. pieces holds each piece's numbers per body: hem = lowest point of a top/dress/outfit torso, top = highest point of a shoe, band = lowest point of a hat near the head.
